summary: Texas Mineral Resources Corp. (TMRC) filed an 8-K to supplement its proxy statement/prospectus regarding its acquisition by USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) via a merger. Pursuant to the March 4, 2026 Merger Agreement, TMRC common stock will be converted into aggregate consideration of 3,823,328 USAR common shares. The board recommended the transaction; the S-4 was declared effective June 29, 2026. Two stockholder lawsuits and several demand letters allege inadequate disclosures. TMRC denies allegations but is supplementing disclosures to avoid delay. Watch for stockholder vote outcome and litigation resolution affecting deal timing.
